information.description:
Beat Cops are the most basic of basic law enforcement, and typically are relegated to crime scene securement or simple odd-jobs. They aren’t heavy fighters, but are still gifted solid gear from the NCPD’s armory that helps marginally boost their chances of survival against anyone other than a homeless refugee.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Ncpd).

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.

Cost: 750eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes
